name: – After recital J – Am 10
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: Ja. Recalls the critical role of Romania’s National Meteorological Administration (ANM), which issued over 35 immediate weather warnings, including 9 red alerts for counties including Bacău, Galați, Iași, Neamț, and Vaslui, where rainfall exceeded 80 litres per square metre; recalls the significant involvement of Romanian national military forces in conducting search and rescue operations in the aforementioned regions;
